Cheesemaking
Making cheese, butter, and other dairy products. But mostly: cheese.
Skill Type:
Trade Skill
Max Level:
80
Skill Trainers:
Fainor
,
Braigon
,
Bendith the Banished
“
People need to make time for cheese In their life.
—
Braigon
Cheesemaking Overview
Cheesemaking
is a time intensive skill revolving around the production of cheeses.
Cheese is marked as a
Prepared Food
and as a
Dairy Dish
for purposes of
gift giving
(ie. earning favor from NPCs).
In-Game Description
Making cheese, butter, and other dairy products. But mostly: cheese.
Training Cheesemaking
Braigon
is a Cheesemaker in
Eltibule
, and is willing to share his craft.
Braigon
can also raise the level cap from 51-60. The first (Level 0) recipe (Butter) can be learned from
Braigon
.
Bendith the Banished
is the trainer in
Fae Realm
. He can unlock levels 61-70
[
Comfortable
]
, 71-80
[
Like Family
]
, and trains various high level recipes.
Hogan
,
Laura Neth
,
Mandibles
, and
Hiral
can train a few random recipes as well.
A few can only be learned from scrolls
Connected Skills
Sub-Skills:
None
Secondary Skills:
Cooking
Related Skills:
Mycology
- Cheesemakers will want to learn
Mycology
, as Rennet is produced through this skill.
Cow
- Cows can make Milk, a necessary ingredient for
Cheesemaking
.
Carpentry
- Carpenters can craft the
Firkins
and
Kilderkins
used in
Cheesemaking
.
Textile Creation
- Cheesemaking requires textiles such as
Butter Muslins
and
Cheesecloths
.
Synergy Levels:
Bonus
Synergy Levels
for
Cheesemaking
can be obtained from the following skills and levels:
Cow
Level 19, Level 41

Cheesemaking Mechanics
Caves
A few
Cheesemaking
recipes require
Kilderkin
or
Firkin
. These cheeses must be aged in caves before they can be consumed.
For example, a
Firkin of Camembert Cheese
must be placed in a cool, damp cave for 2 hours.
Caves that are "cool and damp" are those that have water in them.
Some locations where cheese can be aged:
Crystal Cavern
,
Myconian Cave
,
Brain Bug Cave
,
New Prestonbule Cave
,
Wolf Cave
,
Serbule Hills Spider Cave
.
Some locations where cheese can not be aged:
Rahu Sewer
,
Yeti Cave
Aging
Upon completing aging a cask, you will receive some experience (in addition to that received when crafting the cask, if you had crafted it yourself). This "second round" of experience is unaffected by crafting experience buffs. For casks that produce a variable amount of cheese, the experience received depends on the amount of cheese produced.
Please note, this table is a work-in-progress. Yield of aging may depend on the Cheesemaking Level of the character aging the cask. Note that it is possible to age a cask without possessing the Cheesemaking Level required to produce it.  Currently the table reflects the yield when the character aging the cask is exactly the minimum level to produce it (if there are no errors).

Stomachs
A Cheesemaker will often find themselves in need of a Rennet for their recipes.
Basic Rennet
,
Strong Rennet
, and
Pungent Rennet
are crafted through
Mycology
, and require a supply of
Stomach
s to make.
Whey and Sweet Whey
Some
Cheesemaking
recipes call for a
Bottle of Whey
or
Bottle of Sweet Whey
. These are acidic byproducts of the Cheesemaking process, and certain cheese recipes will produce them.
Whey and sweet whey can be stacked up to ten per slot.
Soybeans & Tofu
Level 35 cheesemakers can start an arduous journey towards producing Tofu by learning the recipe for
Bottle Of Soy Milk
.
Soybeans
, the primary ingredient of
Bottle Of Soy Milk
, can only be naturally harvested in the wilds of
Povus
. When properly processed, Tofu can be used in various
Cooking
recipes.
Soybeans
can be gathered from
Wild Soybean
bushes.
Wild Soybean
bushes grow throughout the
Fall Harvest
season.
Outside of the harvest season, bushes grow only during the New Moon.
Wild Soybean
bushes can also be harvested for a
Soybean Sprout
, which can later be planted and harvested from a garden.
Tofu Press
Converting
Bottle Of Soy Milk
into Tofu requires a Tofu Press.
During the
Fall Harvest
, two Tofu Press can be found near
Ricatu
in the
City of Povus
.
Three Tofu Press are hidden in the cellars of the
Goblin Dungeon
under
Eltibule Keep
.

Trivia
Cheesemaking was the first skill in the game with recipes that took time to complete.
The game reports that the player can put down 3 casks simultaneously at level 40, but in fact, this ability is unavailable until level 41.

lists: Braigonis a Cheesemaker inEltibule, and is willing to share his craft.Braigoncan also raise the level cap from 51-60. The first (Level 0) recipe (Butter) can be learned fromBraigon.
Bendith the Banishedis the trainer inFae Realm. He can unlock levels 61-70[Comfortable], 71-80[Like Family], and trains various high level recipes.
Hogan,Laura Neth,Mandibles, andHiralcan train a few random recipes as well.

Cooking
Mycology- Cheesemakers will want to learnMycology, as Rennet is produced through this skill.
Cow- Cows can make Milk, a necessary ingredient forCheesemaking.
Carpentry- Carpenters can craft theFirkinsandKilderkinsused inCheesemaking.
Textile Creation- Cheesemaking requires textiles such asButter MuslinsandCheesecloths.
Soybeanscan be gathered fromWild Soybeanbushes.
Wild Soybeanbushes grow throughout theFall Harvestseason.
Outside of the harvest season, bushes grow only during the New Moon.
Wild Soybeanbushes can also be harvested for aSoybean Sprout, which can later be planted and harvested from a garden.
During theFall Harvest, two Tofu Press can be found nearRicatuin theCity of Povus.
Three Tofu Press are hidden in the cellars of theGoblin DungeonunderEltibule Keep.
Cheesemaking was the first skill in the game with recipes that took time to complete.
The game reports that the player can put down 3 casks simultaneously at level 40, but in fact, this ability is unavailable until level 41.
